sentences.source: Hello! How are you?
I am good, thank you.
Yes, I am very good, thank you!
No, I am not good.
Yes, please. Thank you and goodbye!
Where are you? I am here.
He is here and she is there.
We are here, and they are there.
Sorry! Who are you?
Now I have time. And you?
He is here, and she is also here.
Coffee with milk, please!
I want tea without milk.
You drink tea, and I drink water.
I eat bread and an apple.
Breakfast is good, but I want more bread, please.
He eats an egg with salt.
Can you help me, please?
Sorry, I can not understand you. Can you speak slowly, please?
Why are you here? I am here because I want to learn.
Meat or fish?
The water is cold, but the tea is very hot.
I have money, and I want to buy bread. Where is the shop?
I want to buy the fish. How much money?
This is my house, and it is very big.
The room has a table, a chair and a bed.
Sorry, where is the door? The window is there.
Open the window and close the door, please!
This book is new, and that book is old.
I can see a small, beautiful house.
The family is big: a mother, a father, a son and a daughter.
All the children are here with the parents.
The mother is here, but the father is not here.
I have a brother and a sister.
The man and the woman are friends.
I know where you live. That man is my friend.
Hello! What is your name?
Come here, please! This street is big, and the school is here.
I live in the city, and I come to your house.
We have a new car, and we can go to school fast.
The morning is beautiful! How are you today?
Today I work all day, and I sleep all night.
Yesterday the evening was cold, but tomorrow is a new day.
Today is Monday, and tomorrow is Tuesday.
Is today Wednesday, Thursday or Friday?
Saturday and Sunday are good: I sleep all day.
I have two brothers and one sister.
When can you come? I have three hours today.
The house has four rooms, five windows and six doors.
The week has seven days, and I work five days.
I want ten apples, nine eggs and eight fish, please.
The child is ten years old, and he always wants to learn.
Ten, nine, eight, seven, three, two, one, zero!
January and February are cold months, but June is hot.
March and April are cold, but May is beautiful.
The water is never cold here, because the sun is always hot.
July and August are hot months, and I am very happy.
September, October and November are cold, but December is beautiful.
December is a happy month: all the family is here.
The car is red, and the house is white.
Give me the black phone, please!
The door is green, the window is blue, and the chair is yellow.
I love the dog, and the child loves the cat.
The dog is brown, and the cat is grey.
I can not find the orange book or the pink phone.
The street is long, but the day is short.
The child has big eyes, small hands and small feet.
I can not take all the books. What can I do? Can you help me?
My head, my hands and my feet are cold.
The work is difficult, but the money is good.
The coffee is bad and expensive. The tea is good and cheap.
I can read and write, but I can not speak fast.
What do you say? I do not know! It is not easy.
